sources.observations: 18 adults; 6 active blocks and 1 passive block of 10 one-minute trials. Both response keys use the dominant hand. Passive alternation is described as final despite randomized-block wording. No horizontal EOG. Paper preprocessing order is reference, filter, downsample, segment. Paper specifies 65 TRF lags at 128 Hz over 0–500 ms but not orientation. Paper describes trial-level 8:1:1 and five-fold evaluation, not this contract's person/mixture split. Data records describe an Excel stimulus-trigger map and passive records. Article license is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; stimulus licensing language is distinct from data license.
